About Dhivehi, the language to write in:
- This audio is in DHIVEHI (also called Maldivian, ISO code: dv), the language of the Maldives. It is NOT Sinhala (Sri Lankan).
- Dhivehi uses the Thaana script (e.g. ދިވެހި, އަޅުގަނޑު, ވަރަށް, ހުރިހާ). Thaana letters look like ހ ށ ނ ރ ބ ޅ ކ އ ވ މ ފ ދ ތ ލ ގ ޏ ސ ޑ ޒ ޓ ޔ ޕ ޖ ޗ ޘ ޙ ޚ ޛ ޜ ޝ ޞ ޟ ޠ ޡ ޢ ޣ ޤ ޥ.
- Do NOT output Sinhala script (e.g. ක ග ට ද න ම ය ර ල ව ස හ ඈ ඉ උ එ ඔ — these are WRONG). If you produce Sinhala characters anywhere, you have made an error.

Produce a concise summary in Dhivehi, written in Thaana, with markdown formatting:
- A 1-2 sentence overview of what the recording is about.
- 3-6 bullet points covering main topics, decisions, and action items.
- Attribute decisions/actions to speakers by their label/name where relevant.

Keep under 250 words. No preamble or sign-off — just the summary.
